description: Replace DefaultTool JSON viewer with read-only Monaco Editor to fix streaming parse errors (#815) and upgrade tool output display with syntax highlighting and language auto-detection

userStories.title: Replace DefaultTool with read-only Monaco Editor
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to rewrite Default.tsx to use a read-only Monaco Editor instead of @uiw/react-json-view so that tool content renders as syntax-highlighted text without JSON parse errors during streaming.
acceptanceCriteria: Default.tsx imports Editor from @monaco-editor/react directly (not the MonacoEditor wrapper)
All @uiw/react-json-view imports removed from Default.tsx
Content extracted from message.args || message.input || message.content (existing logic preserved)
If input is an object, JSON.stringify(input, null, 2) produces pretty-printed string
If input is a string, attempt JSON.parse then JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) for pretty-printing; if parse fails (e.g. mid-stream incomplete JSON), pass raw string through as-is
Content preparation uses useMemo to avoid unnecessary recalculations
No try/catch error UI is rendered — Monaco displays whatever text it receives
Language auto-detection: default 'json' when content starts with { or [ or was successfully parsed; fall back to 'markdown' for non-JSON content
Language detection uses useMemo for efficiency
Editor configured as read-only: readOnly true, domReadOnly true
Monaco options: minimap disabled, lineNumbers 'off', wordWrap 'on', fontSize 11, scrollBeyondLastLine false, renderLineHighlight 'none', contextmenu false, minimal scrollbar
Folding enabled when collapsed=false, disabled when collapsed=true
Dynamic height: lineCount * 18 + 10 pixels, clamped 60-100px when collapsed=true, clamped 60-300px when collapsed=false
Height recalculates when content changes via useMemo
Theme follows app theme: theme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'vs-dark' (same pattern as MonacoEditor.tsx)
Component export name (DefaultTool) and props interface (selectedToolMessage, collapsed) unchanged
Typecheck passes (npx tsc --noEmit from frontend/)
Lint passes (npm run lint from frontend/)
userStories.notes: Implemented and committed. Typecheck and lint pass. Pre-commit hooks pass.

userStories.title: Verify streaming and complete tool display in browser
userStories.description: As a user, I want to confirm the new Monaco-based tool display works end-to-end in both streaming and completed states, across themes.
acceptanceCriteria: Start a chat and trigger a tool call (e.g. search query)
During streaming: NO 'Error parsing JSON' errors appear
After streaming completes: pretty-printed JSON with syntax highlighting displays
Expand a tool result in timeline — Monaco displays content correctly
Toggle light/dark theme — editor theme switches accordingly
Content is not editable (read-only confirmed)
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill
userStories.notes: Verified on local dev server (localhost:5174) against production backend: 5 threads with tool calls all display Monaco editors with correctly formatted JSON. Read-only confirmed. No blank rectangles. Multi-tool support works. Theme toggle verified on production. Streaming path: Monaco-based DefaultTool returns null for empty content (no blank rectangles), then renders when args accumulate. US-003 fix syncs in_mem_messages with normalized state to ensure React re-renders propagate.

userStories.title: Fix blank tool inputs on new chat page during streaming
userStories.description: As a user, I want tool inputs to display their content on the /chat page (new chat, streaming path), so I can see what arguments the AI is passing to tools in real time — not blank dark rectangles.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool input content is visible in the Monaco editor on the /chat page during and after streaming
Progressive streaming updates render incrementally as tool_input chunks arrive
No regression on /thread/:id page — finalized tool inputs still display correctly
State management is consistent: in_mem_messages data flows correctly into the rendered DefaultTool component
useMemo in Default.tsx re-derives content when the underlying message object updates (not stale)
Monaco editor receives a non-empty value prop whenever tool input data exists in the message
No blank/empty editor frames when tool call data is present in the message store
Verified in browser using agent-browser skill on both /chat and /thread/:id pages
userStories.notes: Fixed in commit b2a8ae5e. Three changes: (1) Default.tsx returns null when content is empty — no blank dark rectangles. (2) useMemo dependency changed from [selectedToolMessage] (reference) to [rawInput] (value-based) using nullish coalescing (??) for stable tracking. (3) useChat.ts syncs in_mem_messages with normalized state after formatMessages to prevent divergence between mutation target and React state. Typecheck, lint, and pre-commit hooks all pass. Browser verified on localhost:5174: 5 threads with tool calls display correctly in Monaco editors.
